summary: Frontend-only verification of Expo Go push-notice suppression + local reminder flow. All 5 request criteria PASS. (1) Inbox loads cleanly, no red/white screen. (2) Browser console contains ZERO lines matching the push-notice regex /Android Push notifications \(remote notifications\) functionality provided by expo-notifications was removed/i after full load — the console.error/console.warn patch in app/_layout.tsx works. The only expo-notifications web warning that appears is an unrelated 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' message. (3) Local reminder scheduling works: entered 'Call mum' via reminder-title, kept default mode-time, tapped save-reminder; a reminder with testID 'reminder-1790858223998-6iwu7fenvji' now appears in Upcoming and the text 'Call mum' is visible. No crash. (4) Settings shows the new 'Expo Go note' row (visible text match count = 1) with the explanatory copy. (5) Regression checks pass: Inbox capture-button opens /add composer ('Something worth keeping.'); Archive tab renders ('Reminders archive'); no pageerrors or error-level console logs.
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.ts still imports expo-notifications at module load; the Expo Go SDK 53+ notice originates from the native module probe. Current suppression via console.error/warn override is correct and verified working. Future consideration: when migrating off Expo Go, consider dynamic import gated by Constants.appOwnership !== 'expo' to avoid the notice at source.
seed_data_creation: Created one in-storage reminder 'Call mum' during the save test (local AsyncStorage only, no backend persistence).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expo Router web uses anchor hrefs for bottom tabs: /, /archive, /reminders, /settings — selector 'a[href="/reminders"]' works and avoids collision with the Inbox filter chip labeled 'Reminders'. Do NOT use get_by_text('Reminders') for tab navigation. Reminder cards use testID 'reminder-<id>'; the FAB uses testID 'add-reminder-fab'; reminder form uses testIDs reminder-title, save-reminder, mode-time, mode-place.
rca_of_issue: The original Expo Go 'Android Push notifications ... was removed' error is an SDK 53+ informational notice emitted by expo-notifications when its native push module is unavailable in Expo Go. Recall only uses local scheduled notifications. The fix (patching console.error/console.warn with a regex matcher before the module runs its probe, plus try/catch around setNotificationHandler) suppresses the specific string without masking unrelated errors. Verified: 0 regex matches across the full session covering app launch, tab navigation, reminder save, and composer open.
